title: Chapter 682
text:
The hatch opened, and a strong suction force suddenly stirred up a strong wind, trying to drag him out of the spaceship.

Han Xiao used his Mechanical Force to stimulate the compressed orb, and nanoparticles flowed out like black sand all over his body. They quickly transformed and turned into a strengthened Mountain Ape mechanical suit.

He moved his limbs and jumped out of the spaceship. Blue flames spurted out from the thrusters, and he turned into a meteor and sped toward the rear.

The expedition force was pincered from the front and back. At the same time, they exchanged fire with the Bloodshed Land reinforcements and the enemy's ambush forces.

The deputy took over the commander's job and told the rear team to resist the ambush forces while the front team continued to attack the stargate. Destroying the stargate was still the key to winning this battle.

Han Xiao's goal was to deal with the high-level combatants of the ambush forces. After failing assassination attempts time and time again, he had already proven how difficult he was to deal with. If the enemy did not have a reliable strategy, they would not have tried to assassinate him. He also wanted to see what kind of new assassination package the enemy had prepared for him this time, and he was a little excited.

The galactic battlefield was filled with crisscrossing laser cannons. Han Xiao moved and dodged while flying at high speed, easily avoiding the ion cannons. Not long after, he arrived at the edge of the ambush forces. A stream of light flew over from the enemy's formation. It was Hardaway, who had challenged him.

Hardaway was an old opponent. He did not like to talk and did not want to give Han Xiao time to release the Mech Army. The moment he saw Han Xiao, he did not waste any time and charged forward with the Iron Head Hammer like a mini meteorite.

Han Xiao was not afraid of the sudden attack. His hands turned into cannon barrels, and blue psionic cannons shot out toward Hardaway.

Hardaway did not dodge at all and allowed the psionic cannons to explode on his body. He was not injured at all.

After fighting many times, Han Xiao understood Hardaway's abilities very well. He did not want to injure him but only wanted to slow down Hardaway's charging speed. Making use of this short time, he activated the Army Boxes from afar. The space around him rippled, and the Army Boxes jumped over one after another. The door of the crate opened, and countless compressed orbs rapidly expanded into a mechanical torrent, filling up the small area almost instantly.

The densely packed Mech Legion had reached a scale of 3 million!

In the past three years, the Black Star Corps had earned a lot. Han Xiao had plenty of funds to strengthen and expand the Mech Legion multiple times. Now, even the most common cannon fodder-level mechanical soldier was made of high-grade alloy materials. Its armor and defense were much higher than three years ago. The increase in base stats made the various bonuses even more impressive.

Through the many war missions, Han Xiao had earned a large amount of Amethyst Civilization Contribution Points and had exchanged them for more cutting-edge knowledges. One of them was the [Controllable Annihilation Weapon] of the Armed Forces Branch.

Annihilation weapons were conventional weapons that were one grade higher than energy weapons. Because it was a technological innovation, its power was much higher than normal energy weapons. Furthermore, it required the Cutting-Edge Knowledge [Abnormal State Energy] as a prerequisite. Basically, only psionic energy or antimatter energy could be used to create annihilation weapons.

With these two Cutting-Edge Knowledges, Han Xiao had already changed most of the weapons of his mechanical soldiers to annihilation weapons. Together with [Legendary Battle Techniques] and other talents, their attack power had increased significantly.

In the past three years, Han Xiao had yet to complete his Class Advancement mission. If it were any other class, his strength would not have increased by much. However, the advantage of the Mechanic class was that as long as he had money to burn, even if his strength reached a bottleneck, he could still steadily increase his strength!

Han Xiao had not stopped building his Mech Legion in the past three years. He realized that other than having money, he had another huge advantage, which was that he had far more time than the players.

The Mechanic class happened to be a class that needed time to build all kinds of equipment.

As long as he had money and a liver, increasing his strength would be as easy as drinking water. Among the five Super classes, only the Mage class could be compared to the Mechanic class in this aspect.

With Han Xiao's current strength, any normal Calamity Grade Super that came would basically be killed. After the repeated assassination attempts, the various organizations in the Shattered Star Ring had reached a consensus. Those organizations that secretly planned assassinations would not easily send their high-level combatants to their deaths.

Therefore, the only enemy that Han Xiao was facing now was Hardaway. This guy was a Beyond Grade A seed and did not belong to the category of 'normal Calamity Grades'. Furthermore, his ability was the type that gave Han Xiao a headache.

Hardaway was an Esper, and his ability was' Body Hardening '. This was a common Esper Ability that could be found on the streets. However, he was extremely talented and had developed this Esper Ability to an abnormal degree. His defense was extremely shocking, and he had many Molding Talents. He was a boss-level character.

Firstly, Hardaway had the Molding Talent 'Low Damage Immunity'. He was a tank, and as long as the attack did not exceed a certain standard value, the attack would deal zero damage. This standard value depended on his own defense, and his Esper Ability was' Body Hardening ', which greatly increased his defense. Therefore, focus fire tactics were almost useless against him.

The second thing that gave Han Xiao a headache was that Hardaway also had the Molding Talent 'True Damage Immunity'. Beyond Grade A seeds were all extremely talented and were heroes among bosses. For a super tank like Hardaway, it was not strange for him to have this talent. This made [Legendary Battle Techniques] ineffective against him.

The focus fire effect was poor, and True Damage was ineffective. Han Xiao's two trump cards could not threaten Hardaway, so he could only slowly grind him down.

Every time he fought with Hardaway, it was a process of two huge lumps of meat rubbing against each other. Neither of them could do anything to the other.

Every time Han Xiao defeated Hardaway, he did not kill him. It was not that he did not want to but that he really could not kill this guy before Hardaway escaped. On the other hand, Hardaway seemed to be enjoying the beatings and did not tire of challenging him.

A year ago, Hadavy had suddenly come to find him for a spar. Han Xiao had no enmity with him, so he felt that this must be the result of his enemy adding fuel to the fire. He finally understood how to fight poison with poison.

Aren't you meat? I'll find someone even fatter to disgust you!

In the past, it was the Bloodshed Land who wanted to vomit every time they saw him. Now, it was Han Xiao who wanted to vomit every time he saw Hardaway.

Without any other enemy Calamity Grade Supers, he only had one opponent. There were no other constraints. A portion of the Mech Legion fought with Hardaway according to the set battle mode. These little cuties were more than enough to stall him. Han Xiao was only responsible for providing the Mechanical Force bonuses. He did not want to fight with Hardaway at all. It was a waste of energy.

At the same time, Han Xiao turned around and controlled another portion of the Mech Legion to attack the surrounding enemy fleet. The dense dark blue annihilation rays pierced through the shields of the spaceships, leaving strange colored spots around the holes of the shields. The spaceships lost their shields one after another, and their outer armor was torn apart. Countless metal fragments floated in the air.

Turbulent fire snakes spewed out from the holes in the spaceships, flowing into the vacuum along with the airflow and turning into twisting fire dragons. They lasted for an instant before they ran out of oxygen and were extinguished.

The energy furnace lost its balance, and the spaceships expanded from the inside. Dazzling flames tore through the hull of the spaceships, and violent explosions occurred. The spaceships turned into fireworks in the universe, also disappearing in the blink of an eye.

With the current strength of the Mech Legion, it was not a problem for them to participate in a galactic war. They gradually helped their own fleet stabilize the situation.

After fighting for half a day, the enemy fleet was already showing signs of weakening. The reinforcements of the Bloodshed Land could only struggle at death's door. It was only a matter of time before the stargate was destroyed.

Hardaway also seemed to have thoughts of retreating. He started to shake off the entanglement of the Mech Legion and started to retreat. However, he did not run in the direction of the ambush troops but directly charged into the formation of Han Xiao's fleet, wanting to pass through and escape through the stargate before Han Xiao's fleet completely destroyed the Bloodshed Land's defense line.

"You're running?" Inside the mechanical suit helmet, Han Xiao raised his eyebrows in surprise.

He had thought that there would be some new tricks in this assassination, but he did not expect it to be such a bluff. Even the previous few assassinations were much more powerful than this one.

"It's definitely not that simple. I wonder what he's up to." Han Xiao narrowed his eyes, thought about it, and turned around to chase after Hardaway.

His fleet was in Hardaway's path, and Han Xiao was not going to sit back and watch him charge into his fleet. If Hardaway wanted to do something, the others would not be able to stop him.

The two of them chased, and Han Xiao gradually closed the distance between them. Behind him, millions of mechanical soldiers followed like millions of meteors, majestic.

Han Xiao finally caught up to Hardaway when they arrived at the frontline. Seeing that Hardaway had already passed through his fleet, he stopped and did not plan to continue the chase.

This time, Hardaway did not continue to run. He suddenly turned around and charged toward Han Xiao, trying to break through the fierce focus fire.

"This is a little strange." Han Xiao became alert and was about to dodge when the mechanical suit's radar suddenly rang, showing thirty high-energy reaction sources!

Thirty Grade A Supers suddenly appeared in the surrounding Bloodshed Land's reinforcement fleet and charged toward Han Xiao. Han Xiao even saw Wrothers and the other Vanguard Officials. They had followed the reinforcement fleet through the stargate and had not attacked the few Calamity Grade Supers of the Black Star Corps. They had been waiting patiently for this opportunity!

The attacks of the thirty Calamity Grade Supers came from all directions, bringing immense pressure. Han Xiao hurriedly controlled the Mech Legion to block, but Hardaway found an opening. This iron-headed brat smashed through all the mechanical soldiers in his way and collided with Han Xiao.

Han Xiao's waist tightened, and he realized that Hardaway's hands were tightly wrapped around his body, unable to break free. Hardaway carried him and charged toward the stargate.

The thirty Calamity Grade Supers ignored the harassment of the Mech Legion and bombarded Hardaway with attacks one after another, madly increasing his speed.

The surrounding Bloodshed Land fleets gave up all attacks and desperately defended against the attacks of Han Xiao's fleet, desperately protecting the stargate.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's brain worked quickly, and he immediately understood the other party's entire plan.

This is for Hardaway to pretend to ambush me, force me to fight, and then pretend to retreat, leading me near the stargate. The other dozens of Calamity Grade Supers secretly returned to the Sol Cluster from the three border Star Systems and waited for orders with the reinforcements. The Bloodshed Land knows that I will attack the last logistics transit station, so this is a trap they deliberately exposed. Their goal is to let these Calamity Grade Supers follow the reinforcements to this battlefield through the stargate. Their goal is not to kill me but to help Hardaway control me and send me into the stargate!

On the other side of the stargate was the Sol Cluster, which was the headquarters of the Klent Kingdom and Bloodshed Land!

"Ha, I get it. You want to lure me into your territory. This way, I will be isolated and helpless, and you can slowly torture me. Even if you can't kill me, you can easily capture me alive."

Han Xiao felt a headache. These little bastards really have imagination. Are they trying to elope with me?

Hardaway's physique could easily withstand the continuous bombardment, and his flying speed became faster and faster. The Bloodshed Land battleships along the way opened a path for him, and the blue vortex in the center of the stargate expanded rapidly in Han Xiao's vision, getting closer and closer.

Seeing that the strategy was about to succeed, Hardaway could not help but send a voice message to Han Xiao, who was right in front of him.

"When we reach the Sol Cluster, let's have a good fight again. By the way, do you want me to ask them to bring your Mech Legion over as well? That way, we can have a good fight." Hardaway's tone was sincere.

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. "You're quite f * cking sincere. Since you like to fight with me so much, let go of me if you have the guts. As long as you don't run away, I'll fight with you until you're satisfied."

"No, fighting is one thing. I don't want to die."

Hardaway shook his head, increased the strength of his arms, and tightly hugged Han Xiao's waist, stubbornly flying with Han Xiao.

"You really think highly of me …"

Han Xiao was speechless.

To be honest, he did not have any grudges against Hardaway. Hardaway was not interested in the secret war at all and only wanted to find him to fight. As the saying went, no discord, no concord. The two of them had clashed so many times, and they were both Beyond Grade A seeds. Sometimes, they would even chat while fighting …
